intent: session-open: bounded diagnostic log for non-happy-path statuses
notes: **Closed the "silent-hook = silent-regression" contract loophole.** Vendor SessionStart hooks (Claude / Codex / Gemini) invoke `gator-session-open.py` under a strict rule: no stdout, always exit 0. That rule was never wrong — but the previous implementation was also blind: when `ensure_git_hooks()` returned a non-happy-path status (`degraded` / `unavailable` / `error`), that status went nowhere. B1 fixed the AttributeError; B3 makes the recovered-but-not-quite state visible.

**New module** `src/gator_command/templates/gator-starter/scripts/gator_diagnostics.py`. Template-only (session hooks are template-only). Exports `log_hook_event(gator_dir, script_name, status, detail)` — bounded, append-only log at `.gator/diagnostics/hooks.log`, capped at `MAX_LINES = 200` via oldest-drops truncation, every code path wrapped in try/except so a diagnostic write can never affect the caller's exit code. Also exports `NON_HAPPY_STATUSES = frozenset({"degraded", "unavailable", "error"})` so callers don't hardcode the vocabulary from `gator-init.ensure_git_hooks()`'s return contract.

**Wired into `gator-session-open.py::main()`**: captures the `ensure_git_hooks()` return dict, checks the lowercase status against `NON_HAPPY_STATUSES`, and calls `log_hook_event()` when the shoe fits. Guarded import: if `gator_diagnostics` isn't shipped yet (old template on a not-yet-updated fleet repo), session-open degrades to pre-B3 behavior — still exit 0, still no stdout, no log entry. Forward-compat across the fleet during template rollout. Also added a `SKIP` entry when `paths.layout == "invalid"` so that early-return leaves evidence too.

**Gitignore extension**: `ensure_repo_gitignore()` at `src/gator_command/scripts/gatorize.py:357` now adds `.gator/diagnostics/` to the repo's `.gitignore`. Because `gator-update.main()` calls `ensure_repo_gitignore()` on every update (see `execute_updates()` charter entry), the rule propagates fleet-wide with zero per-repo work. Same-commit edit to this repo's root `.gitignore` so the rule is live before B3's first fire — otherwise the log file would surface in `git status` and defeat the "private diagnostic residue" contract Codex flagged in the plan-review pass.

**Regression pins** in the new `tests/test_session_hooks.py`: 8 test cases. Diagnostics covers write-first-line, status uppercasing, newline stripping in detail, rotation-at-cap, never-raises-on-bad-path, never-raises-on-permission-error. Session-open wire-up covers degraded-status-writes-log and ok-status-writes-no-log. All pass; 158 pre-existing tests across `test_layout.py` / `test_hooks.py` / `test_gatorize.py` / `test_init.py` still green.

**Charter updates** (`scripts-installer.md`): revised `gator-session-open.py::main()` to describe the diagnostics wire-up and log-write side effect; added new `log_hook_event()` entry with tripwires (never-raise contract, `NON_HAPPY_STATUSES` sync obligation with `ensure_git_hooks`, MAX_LINES rotation invariant tied to a regression pin); extended `ensure_repo_gitignore()` to name the new rule and note the fleet propagation contract.

Part of the "update and begin-session bugs" fix set (plan: `.gator/vault/artifacts/2026-08-03-update-and-begin-session-bugs-implementation-plan.md`, step B3 of B1→B2→A1→A4→A2→B3→A3). B1 fixed the crash; B3 closes the observability gap so the next silent regression at this seam surfaces as a log entry, not a mystery.
